rules.R1: family components / entry-point owners (graph families[].components, entry_points -> owns)
rules.R10: declared worker fleet of an included real-binary service (svc -depends_on-> worker in the graph)
rules.R11: compose-declared worker fleet of an included real binary: every real-binary recipe running the same image (the binary's worker roles are declared in the compose definition, e.g. fts `-command=rbl::check_transfer_status`; the graph covers only source-analysed queues)
rules.R2: journey definitions of the family: journey -> depends_on -> substitute
rules.R3: calls closure over included services (svc/worker/sub -calls-> svc/sub; ext -> implemented by sub)
rules.R4: datastore edges (depends_on/reads/writes/produces/consumes -> db:* -> compose service in twin_ref)
rules.R6: compose-declared and config-template service references of included services (http://<service>:<port>, "host:port", {{SVC.<key>.host|url}} tokens rendered from config/arena.yaml, {{MOZART.url}}, {{WORKFLOW_HOST}})
rules.R7: journey harness requirements (container targets the runner/provisioner exec into)
rules.R8: one-shot migration jobs for included real-binary images whose datastore is included
rules.R9: Source-to-Pay overlay closure (s2p-vp-source needs api-ingress + its private datastores)
